achievement.timelordregen.description.wa: Obtain a pocket watch — a vessel that holds regeneration energy.
achievement.timelordregen.title.watch: More than just a pocket watch!
The gods who walk in the shadows have for the first time become aware of incredible science.
advancements.timelordregen.unbearably_pa: You feel your organs growing, and your cells multiplying like never before.
advancements.timelordregen_gallifrey.des: A rust-coloured planet outside of time, its interior as rusty as its exterior — and laggy.
command.regen.detimelord.success: Modified %s's biological data to non-Time Lord.
command.regen.fail: No regenerations left or already regenerating!
command.regen.name: Regenerate
command.regen.settimelord.success: Modified %s's biological data to Time Lord.
command.regen.not_timelord: You are not a Time Lord!
command.regen.fail.invulnerable: Your cells are still too energized to force regeneration.
gui.regen.settings.title: Regeneration Settings
gui.regen.settings.not_timelord: You are not a Time Lord
item.timelordregen.elixir_of_life.desc.s: §7Drink the elixir, and your body will undergo some changes...
item.timelordregen.elixir_of_life.desc.l: §7§oGrants the regenerative abilities and physiological traits of a Gallifreyan*transforming them into a true Time Lord*If already a Time Lord, §cgrants a new regeneration cycle
item.timelordregen.pocket_watch.desc.lon: §7§oBinds to its first user, allowing transfer of regeneration charges between player and watch
origin.timelordregen.regeneration.descri: Phantoms no longer spawn around you. A transparent hardened membrane grows beneath your skin. You can survive longer underwater and in a vacuum, and you consume less food. Additionally, your body has a way of cheating death by regenerating all its cells, but only a limited twelve times.
origin.timelordregen.regeneration.name: Gallifreyan Physiology
origin.timelordregen.timelord.descriptio: She saw the gods themselves, not as mortals see them, but as they see each other: infinite living fire, an eternal serpent biting its own tail; wheel within wheel, rotating with the same elegance as the stars in the night sky. Burning eyes, unblinkingly watching every sun and planet in creation, counting days and nights.
origin.timelordregen.timelord.name: Time Lord
message.timelordregen.cannot_force_regen: §cYou cannot force regeneration while your cells are still rich with energy!
message.timelordregen.pocket_watch.whisp: Can you hear it? That ancient heartbeat...
The skies of Gallifrey... are still burning...
Twelve times... is far from enough...
message.timelordregen.energy.empty: Not enough regeneration energy — crack a regeneration (%s)
config.timelordregen.title: Regeneration Energy
config.timelordregen.remote: Set by the server you're on.
config.timelordregen.group.presets.desc: Overwrites all the server values below. You can still tweak them after.
config.timelordregen.preset.balanced.des: Defaults. Strong, but everything costs you regenerations.
config.timelordregen.preset.trenzalore.d: Over the top numbers. Fine for fun worlds, breaks survival.
config.timelordregen.energyPerRegen.desc: Energy you get from cracking one regeneration. Keep it at or under the cap or cracking never fits. Transfers that overflow a Time Lord turn back into a regeneration at this rate.
config.timelordregen.energyCap.desc: Max energy a Time Lord can hold.
config.timelordregen.tardisSafe.desc: Blast, release and chain inside a TARDIS are just a light show. No damage, knockback, block breaking or fire.
config.timelordregen.tardisRestore.desc: Slowly refills your energy while you're inside a TARDIS.
config.timelordregen.tardisFuelPerEnergy: Artron fuel spent per point of energy. 0 = free, a full tank is 50000.
config.timelordregen.chargeTicks.desc: How long Z has to be held before the beam fires. Let go earlier and you cast the chain.
config.timelordregen.beamDrain.desc: Energy per tick while firing (20 ticks = 1s)
config.timelordregen.beamRadius.desc: How close to the beam you have to be to get hit, in blocks.
config.timelordregen.beamSpread.desc: Hit radius grows by this much per block of distance.
config.timelordregen.beamDamage.desc: Per tick, to everything in the beam. Skips the hurt cooldown, so 20 ticks = 20 hits.
config.timelordregen.knockback.desc: Multiplier for every push: beam, impact, release, chain.
config.timelordregen.ignoresArmor.desc: Armor does nothing against the energy.
config.timelordregen.playerDamage.desc: Multiplier for damage to players. PvP settings still apply.
config.timelordregen.releaseDamage.desc: Shockwave when you let go of the beam, weaker further out.
config.timelordregen.maxHardness.desc: Nothing harder than this breaks. Stone is 1.5, obsidian 50. Wither/dragon immune blocks never break.
config.timelordregen.beamBreakRadius.des: Blocks crumble within this radius of where the beam hits. Big values are heavy on the server.
config.timelordregen.beamBreakPower.desc: How fast the beam wears blocks down, divided by hardness every tick.
config.timelordregen.impactBreakRadius.d: Crater radius per impact. Big values are heavy on the server.
config.timelordregen.impactBreakPower.de: How much each impact wears blocks down, divided by hardness.
Soft blocks around you break within this radius on release. Big values are heavy on the server.
config.timelordregen.releaseBreakHardnes: Hardest block the release can break.
config.timelordregen.fires.desc: Fires each impact tries to light. 0 = none
config.timelordregen.chainEnabled.desc: Tap Z at a mob and the energy jumps from target to target.
config.timelordregen.chainRange.desc: Max distance to the first target.
config.timelordregen.chainRadius.desc: How far from the first target the chain can get.
config.timelordregen.chainHop.desc: Longest single jump between two targets.
config.timelordregen.chainCost.desc: Energy per target. The chain stops early when you run out.
config.timelordregen.chainCooldown.desc: Ticks until you can chain again.
config.timelordregen.chainDamage.desc: Damage to each target in the chain.
config.timelordregen.chainSplashDamage.d: Damage to anything else caught in each blast.
config.timelordregen.chainCraterRadius.d: Crater radius at each target. 0 = no craters
config.timelordregen.chainCraterHardness: Hardest block a chain crater can break.
config.timelordregen.maxAbsorption.desc: At full health pulses give absorption up to this (2 = one golden heart)
How much of it arrives. Under 1 some gets lost, over 1 makes energy out of nothing.
config.timelordregen.transferRange.desc: Max distance to the other player.
config.timelordregen.transferGrantsRegen: Overflowing a Time Lord's reserve gives them a regeneration.
config.timelordregen.particles.desc: Multiplier on top of vanilla's particle setting.
config.timelordregen.beamScale.desc: Beam and arc thickness. Visual only.
config.timelordregen.shake.desc: Multiplier on top of vanilla's distortion effects.
config.timelordregen.vignette.desc: Gold glow at the screen edges while charging and firing.
config.timelordregen.glare.desc: White flash when you let go of the beam.
config.timelordregen.handGlow.desc: Sparks in your hands while healing in first person.
config.timelordregen.hud.desc: When to show the energy bar above the hotbar.
message.timelordregen.energy.chain_coold: The energy needs %s more seconds to settle
config.timelordregen.burnLoot.desc: Mobs killed by the energy turn to dust, no loot. Gear, saddles, chests and XP still drop.
config.timelordregen.chainAimAssist.desc: How far off the crosshair a mob can be and still get picked, in blocks.
config.timelordregen.transferHeal.desc: Health per pulse for players who aren't Time Lords.
